signals.text: Recently added to Tolara — hiring trends need a week of history

bullets: Lead market immersion to deeply understand and anticipate the evolving needs of the customers we serve
Identify and evaluate high-impact opportunities that align with our long-term business strategy and drive customer success
Make strategic decisions on product direction and own the outcomes of those decisions
Regularly assess and refine product strategy as market conditions and company objectives change
Turn complex data into insights that feed directly into product development and strategy
